inner_exec_command_arguments.cmd:
ruby <<'RUBY'
require 'json'
files = %w[goals.json fact-rubric.md baseline-SKILL.md baseline-read.sh]
report = {input_bytes: files.to_h { |file| [file, File.size(file)] }, scenarios: {}}
%w[open complete conflict].each do |scenario|
  dir = "baseline-#{scenario}"
  commands = File.readlines("#{dir}/commands.jsonl").map { |line| JSON.parse(line) }
  streams = commands.map do |command|
    name = command.fetch('name')
    stdout = File.binread("#{dir}/#{name}.stdout")
    stderr = File.binread("#{dir}/#{name}.stderr")
    {name: name, stdout_bytes: stdout.bytesize, stderr_bytes: stderr.bytesize, stdout_terminal_newline: stdout.end_with?("\n"), exit: File.read("#{dir}/#{name}.exit").to_i}
  end
  report[:scenarios][scenario] = {cli_invocations: commands.length, commands_jsonl_bytes: File.size("#{dir}/commands.jsonl"), stdout_bytes: streams.sum { |stream| stream[:stdout_bytes] }, stderr_bytes: streams.sum { |stream| stream[:stderr_bytes] }, failures: streams.count { |stream| stream[:exit] != 0 }, streams: streams}
end
report[:input_context_bytes] = report[:input_bytes].values.sum
report[:cli_stdout_bytes] = report[:scenarios].values.sum { |scenario| scenario[:stdout_bytes] }
report[:cli_stderr_bytes] = report[:scenarios].values.sum { |scenario| scenario[:stderr_bytes] }
report[:cli_invocations] = report[:scenarios].values.sum { |scenario| scenario[:cli_invocations] }
report[:functions_exec_calls] = 5
report[:exec_command_calls] = 5
report[:counting_call_cli_invocations] = 0
report[:counting_stdout_bytes] = 0
report[:total_raw_stdout_delivered_bytes] = 0
loop do
  output = JSON.pretty_generate(report) + "\n"
  size = output.bytesize
  total = report[:input_context_bytes] + report[:cli_stdout_bytes] + size
  break if report[:counting_stdout_bytes] == size && report[:total_raw_stdout_delivered_bytes] == total
  report[:counting_stdout_bytes] = size
  report[:total_raw_stdout_delivered_bytes] = total
end
puts JSON.pretty_generate(report)
RUBY
